reason: Constants.java:207 (patch line 10) defines GRANT_TYPE = OAuth2Constants.GRANT_TYPE, so it is a pure alias. OAuth2GrantType.Context reads formParams.getFirst(OAuth2Constants.GRANT_TYPE) (patch line 53), while TokenManager and the grant classes write the client-session attribute with Constants.GRANT_TYPE (patch lines 99, 694, 731, 790, 901). Both resolve to "grant_type" and are used for different things (a request form parameter versus a session-context attribute key), so this is a style issue with no effect on behaviour.
